utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m in for the repair drive, Dane—just tell me what needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—let’s start with the busted bikes and the loose fence by the garden.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good—I’ll start with the bikes, then we can tackle that fence by the garden.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hey Hana, I can help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo. Can you confirm whether we’ve already sorted tools and pickup times, or are those still open?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Those are still open as far as I know. If you want, I can sort the tools list and lock in pickup times today.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a running list of nails, tarps, and work gloves for the repair drive—tell me what we’re short on, and I’ll mark it down.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I think we’re running low on tarps and maybe work gloves too—sorry, I lost track of the nails.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Got it—I’ll mark us low on tarps and likely work gloves, and we can double-check the nails before the next pickup.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard a little about it, but not much yet—what kind of repairs are folks focusing on?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Mostly small fixes, I think—leaky faucets, loose steps, that sort of thing. I just hope they’ve got a clear sign-up plan so people aren’t waiting around all day.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, that makes sense. If they keep it organized, I could probably help with a few simple fixes.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Nell, what exactly still needs fixing for the repair drive, and who’s handling what?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: From what I’ve heard, the main things left are a couple porch steps, the fence by the alley, and some patching at the community shed. I think Jonah’s taking the fence, and Bea said she’d organize tools, but I’d want to double-check the rest.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Alright—can you confirm who’s on the porch steps and shed patching, and whether we’ve got the materials already?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Gus, I’ve been hearing folks are really rallying around the repair drive—sounds like a good few people are planning to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’s good to hear—if they need extra hands or a spare drill, I’m happy to lend both.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s kind of you, Gus—I’ll pass it along, because I heard the Bakers are still short on tools for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Opal, I’m telling everyone about the repair drive—want to come by and maybe bring a neighbor too?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can stop by—what’s the exact location and time, so I can pass it along accurately?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It’s this Saturday from 10 to 2 at the Maple Street community garden shed—please spread the word to anyone who likes fixing things.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m in for the repair drive—tell me what needs fixing and I’ll lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: That’s good to hear, Sam, but can you confirm what tools and time you’re actually bringing before we count you in?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can bring my drill, socket set, and extension cords, and I’m free Saturday from 9 to 1. If that works, put me down wherever I’m most useful.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Bo, I’m glad you caught me—can we go over the repair drive list and make sure we’ve got every house covered?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, sure—let’s do a quick pass and make sure nobody got missed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect—let’s start at Maple Street and check each house one by one so we don’t miss anyone.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ve been telling folks about the repair drive, and I’ll keep spreading the word to Eli too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik—I appreciate that. Just let me know the day and time, and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely—I’ll keep asking around and I’ll pass the day and time along to you as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive—I meant to bring my toolbox, but I can still come help if you tell me where to be.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’s kind of you, Oren. Just meet by the community shed at ten, and we’ll find something useful for you to do.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it—community shed at ten. I’ll do my best not to forget this time.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Ira, I’m glad you asked about the repair drive—it’s a nice chance to get everyone helping each other out. I can help spread the word if you want.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That sounds great, Jules—if you can spread the word, I’d really appreciate it while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—I’ll mention it to folks on my block and text a couple people from the garden group too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Dane, we’re getting a repair drive together soon—want me to spread the word and get a few more neighbors in on it?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, please do—I’ll probably roll in a bit late, but I’m in.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect—I’ll let a few folks know and tell them you’re in, even if you’re coming a little later.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard a little about it, but not the details yet—what needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Mostly small house fixes—loose railings, leaky faucets, and a few porch steps. Let’s make a simple list first, then see who can help with each job.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds manageable—if you make the list, I can ask around quietly and see who’s good with railings or plumbing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with the repair drive, but I need to work around school pickup and drop-off times.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That helps a lot, Faye—I really appreciate it. Tell me your pickup and drop-off windows, and I’ll make sure we fit your repair drive shift around them.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Mara. I’m tied up around 7:30–8:30 for drop-off and 2:30–3:30 for pickup, but I’m free in between if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Vik, I’m glad you brought up the repair drive—I can help pull a few people together from different circles if that’d be useful.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That’d be really helpful, Jules—I’m trying to pull a few people together from different circles for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—I can reach out to a few folks from the garden group and the parents’ circle and see who’s up for helping.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring my toolbox by the repair drive if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps, thanks—can you also text me what’s in it so we don’t duplicate tools?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing—I’ll text you a quick list tonight so you can compare before the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Rosa, do you know exactly where the repair drive is set up?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes—it's set up in the community room at Maple Court, right by the front entrance.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rosa—I’ve got it marked: community room at Maple Court, right by the front entrance.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hana, how many houses have actually signed up for the repair drive so far?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I want to make sure I’ve got the latest count before I say—can you give me a second to check the sign-up sheet?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure—just tell me the number once you’ve checked, and whether we’ve got enough volunteers lined up too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We still need a few basic supplies sorted—tape, extension cords, and some cleaning rags. Can you help me check what we already have before we ask around for more?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure—I can check my garage for tape and extension cords, and I’ll see if I’ve got any spare rags too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I only heard about the repair drive from Mara, so I’m still a little fuzzy on the details—do you know what they still need?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I think they still need basic tools and maybe a couple more volunteers, but I might’ve missed an update.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That matches what I heard too—if you catch a firmer update, will you let me know so I don’t keep passing along half-right info?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are we definitely doing the repair drive this weekend, or is that still just the plan?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: As far as I’ve heard, it’s still on for this weekend, but folks are waiting on one last confirmation.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, then let me know once that last confirmation comes through—I don’t want to count on it until it’s definite.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it — I’m out running errands, but keep me posted on how the repair drive’s coming along.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It’s moving, slowly. I’ll let you know if we get enough together by tonight.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Uli — I’m rooting for it. Just send me a quick update tonight when you know.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive—I meant to bring my toolbox by this morning. What do you still need from me?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just bring the toolbox and any spare screws you’ve got; we’re mostly set otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it, I’ll bring the toolbox and whatever spare screws I can find—give me a minute to make sure I don’t forget them again.
